text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, totally bono-buono!
What did you all think?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with this...!
I really think it'd be a huge hit
if we serve it at the actual event.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I bet even the Chairwoman will be shocked~!
Once we bring this out!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman... You're right!
I want the Chairwoman to try some too!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "You must be busy, yet you always make time to come to the fields."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'd love to make them happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Was I dozing off?
This won't do. I still have a mountain of
preparations left for the event."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: (I can't let our regular duties slip either. Thinking of the students working hard growing vegetables right now—spirits, fully charged!)
